title: Query for CPIO Details of Central Public Authorities
issuer: Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India
excerpt: The directory supports ministry, department and public-authority selection and states that each public authority enters and updates its own CPIO data in RTI-MIS.
notes: Verified as a discovery source only. It does not by itself establish a complete designation-based PIO/FAA service address for a launch authority.

technical.notes: Scope and self-maintained-data warning checked on the official page.
